test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
In the early 18th century, people in England drank a lot of gin because of which of the following reasons?

a. It was cheap.

b. It was easily available.

c. For many poor people drinking gin was their only comfort.

options.text: Only a and b are correct.
Only b and c are correct.
Only a and c are correct.
a, b and c all are correct.

solution:
The correct answer is "**a, b and c all are correct.**"
